cards.prose: Luke's night has two men in one bed, and *the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left*, set right after the flood and the fire that carried the careless away. Matthew's field shows who the two are: good seed sown by the man, and tares sown among the wheat by his enemy, growing in the one field.
cards.member_sentence: Matthew's field holds two seeds, good seed and tares, growing in one place, which is the picture behind two in one bed and only one taken.
